thread:
ida (Design): Quick heads-up from usability testing: the new smoothing makes some tiny but important blips feel like 'ghost noise' 5% of testers missed them. We need an approach that keeps visual cleanliness but preserves actionable spikes.

ben (PM): We shouldn't change global defaults. Proposal: per-panel 'spike sentinel' mode that preserves short peaks. Could be a small toggle in the chart controls. :bulb:

caro (Viz Eng): I hacked a 'spike-sentinel' mode that uses adaptive prominence + peak thinning. Config example:
```
mode: spike-sentinel
prominence_factor: 2.2
min_width_secs: 2
max_markers: 8
```
Works on error-rate and p99 latency traces.

nate (A11y): Accessibility checklist: preserved spikes must be focusable, have an aria-label like "preserved spike: +120ms at 12:04 UTC", and not rely on color. Use shape + pattern for colorblind themes. Contrast needs recheck on dark mode.

ida (Design): Copy for the toggle: "Spike sentinel (keep short peaks)". For the legend, avoid inline badges that push series names. Idea: micro-legend drawer 5px chevron to expand per-series settings (shows "smoothing:on  sentinel:on  thresh=auto").

ben (PM): Important: thresholds must be metric-aware (rate vs latency vs count). Recommend 'auto' default with manual override per-panel. Show a tiny 'sentinel' badge in legend only when a recent peak was preserved (last 5m).

caro (Viz Eng): Implementation notes: two-line legend layout is easiest: line 1 = name, line 2 = collapsed state string. Need to cap DOM spike markers to avoid render slowdowns; preserve N most recent peaks. Also add debug overlay toggle for QA to show preserved indices.

nate (A11y): Keyboard shortcut suggestion: press 'Shift+S' when a chart has focus to toggle Spike Sentinel. Tooltip "Shift+S: toggle spike sentinel" should appear. Also ensure screen reader announces "spike sentinel on" when toggled.

mock-bot: Mockups uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/spike_sentinel_compact_v1.png

ida (Design): I'll draft the component spec (copy, micro-legend behavior, responsive rules) and open a PR with QA list: keyboard nav, screen reader strings, dark/light contrast, marker cap stress test.

ben (PM): Plan: rollout on staging behind a feature flag, A/B test for 2 weeks measuring alert recall and false positives.

caro (Viz Eng): Dev note: add panel-level hint for metric_type so heuristics can adapt. Also add telemetry for preserved-peaks-per-panel so we can tune defaults.

nate (A11y): I'll add accessibility test cases to the QA checklist.
